steps.intent: Open the reply composer via the Reply link
Write an AI-generated reply tailored to the email (the recorded text is only an example) into the Message Body
Wait for the 'Draft saved' notice confirming the auto-save; do not press Send
Return to the inbox via 'Back to Inbox' and repeat for the next unread email

dataFlow.field: sender name / email body (context for reply text)

successCriteria: After typing, the 'Draft saved' toast (#toast) appears
The Drafts counter (#dcount) increases by one per processed email
The Message Body textbox contains the generated reply text
No Send button is clicked; the email is not sent
consequentialActions: Send email (Send button in the reply composer) — the widget must never press Send; the user only saved a draft

strategyHints.reason: Click unread row (tr.zA.zE) in the Inbox grid; no network calls observed
Read subject/sender/body from the message view DOM
Click [aria-label="Reply"] link; composer appears in DOM
Insert text into contenteditable Message Body and dispatch input events; no network observed
Auto-save is signalled only by the 'Draft saved' live text and #dcount change
Click 'Back to Inbox' button to return to the grid

openQuestions: Should the widget reply to all unread emails, or only the currently open / newest N?
What tone or length should the AI-written replies have (e.g. brief acknowledgement vs. detailed answer)?
